scope: Source-sense verification of the 160 previously unverified entries retained in the consolidated draft. Exact cached lemma/POS retrieval is followed by AI sense comparison against the definition, example and existing Slovak hint; targeted primary-page checks fill some gaps. Source absence is not evidence that a word is invalid. No new independent Slovak review, official CEFR grading, learner-text edit or production publication.

sources.attribution: Multilingual Central Repository 3.0 (release 2016), González-Agirre, Laparra and Rigau (2012), packaged by Open Multilingual Wordnet 2.0.
sources.redistributionScope: Commercial reuse, redistribution, and adaptation are permitted with attribution. Only the Spanish omw-es module is extracted.
transformations: Extract Spanish lemma, universal POS, lexical-entry ID, sense ID, synset ID, ILI and any source definition/examples as review evidence.
Match the fixed ELELex-derived course catalog by normalized Spanish lemma and compatible POS.
Retain original source identifiers; do not copy source glosses into learner content.

transformations: Extract English definitions, examples and member lemmas verbatim as review evidence only.
Match Spanish offsets and POS, with exact-offset adjective a to satellite s fallback only when the direct ID is absent; require equal non-empty ILIs.
Group Spanish choices by synset, retaining source-order canonical sense IDs and every original source-sense alias.
